rv.q: This is a show that doesn't seem quite sure of itself.
The script, alas, is an amalgamation of poe-faced classical poetry and the sources are meticulously listed in the programme.
This isn’t a great show but it will appeal to committed head-bangers who have already seen Bat Out of Hell six times.
This should have been a fun and silly knight out, but sadly it never rose to the occasion.

cn.t: Critics largely pan this 80s rock-infused medieval musical as incoherent and unnecessary, though some find the bombastic anthems paired with knights and chivalry occasionally entertaining.
